problem_text:
A logistics company needs to distribute a total shipment volume among 12 different regional warehouses to maximize the total expected delivery efficiency. The characteristics of each warehouse are as follows:
* Warehouse 1: expected efficiency is 0.040, handling cost is 0.034, capacity limits [0.083, 0.451]
* Warehouse 2: expected efficiency is 0.066, handling cost is 0.038, capacity limits [0.088, 0.342]
* Warehouse 3: expected efficiency is 0.150, handling cost is 0.292, capacity limits [0.074, 0.793]
* Warehouse 4: expected efficiency is 0.024, handling cost is 0.234, capacity limits [0.044, 0.847]
* Warehouse 5: expected efficiency is 0.113, handling cost is 0.165, capacity limits [0.082, 0.545]
* Warehouse 6: expected efficiency is 0.159, handling cost is 0.192, capacity limits [0.007, 0.571]
* Warehouse 7: expected efficiency is 0.113, handling cost is 0.071, capacity limits [0.069, 0.543]
* Warehouse 8: expected efficiency is 0.112, handling cost is 0.193, capacity limits [0.002, 0.490]
* Warehouse 9: expected efficiency is 0.108, handling cost is 0.072, capacity limits [0.072, 0.534]
* Warehouse 10: expected efficiency is 0.073, handling cost is 0.209, capacity limits [0.004, 0.371]
* Warehouse 11: expected efficiency is 0.137, handling cost is 0.252, capacity limits [0.007, 0.304]
* Warehouse 12: expected efficiency is 0.078, handling cost is 0.070, capacity limits [0.018, 0.732]

Each warehouse must receive a proportion of the total shipment volume that stays within its individual capacity limits, and the sum of all distribution proportions must equal one. To maintain operational flexibility, the company requires that the group of high-accessibility warehouses, represented by the subset H = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12}, collectively handle at least 0.480 of the total volume. Simultaneously, the overall distribution cost, measured by a composite cost index, must not exceed 0.206, and the total expected delivery efficiency must be no less than 0.085. Determine the optimal distribution plan that maximizes total expected delivery efficiency while satisfying all constraints.
